static_traits.name: 刘晨
static_traits.social_status: 与家人和朋友关系因求职观念受影响而紧张，但Has one supportive friend可倾诉
static_traits.medical_history: without类似心理问题史；without既往心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高，情绪偏Anxiety；思维中可见灾难化、过度概括、跳到结论（预测not yet来）与心理过滤等倾向

basic_info.main_problem: 我相信自己永远without法找到一份白天的工作，因为我更喜欢夜晚而not是白天。这种信念导致我感到without望和缺乏动力，并让我回避申请白天职位，只寻找夜班工作。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I noticed this belief limits my job opportunities and affects my overall well-being.
growth_experiences: 几个月前拒绝了一份职业篮球的机会；此后逐渐形成“自己without法胜任白天工作”的信念，并伴随without望与Insufficient motivation的体验；求职压力被认为是加重该信念的因素。
长期更偏好夜间作息，但never真正尝试过全职白天工作，这一偏好逐步被等同为“without法适应白天工作”。

core_beliefs: 我缺乏适应日间作息的能力

special_situations.event: When needing to search or browse daytime job postings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我接受白天工作，我会一直疲惫、not适应，表现会很差
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids applying for daytime positions; only focuses on and applies to night-shift positions

special_situations.event: Imagines the daily arrangements and performance once accepting a daytime job
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能完全适应白天作息，就等于失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 维持夜间作息，not去尝试白天岗位以避免“失败”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只要适应得not够好，就会一without是处

special_situations.event: Talking with family or friends about job seeking and routines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我尝试白天工作却表现not好，就会被他们看not起或negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces discussing this topic with them, insists on only looking for night shifts to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我not行/在苛责我

special_situations.event: 回想起曾拒绝职业篮球机会
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Missing that opportunity means I will easily fail in the future too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将“夜晚偏好”用作not尝试白天工作的理由，以避免再次失败
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我错过了唯一的机会，之后做什么都not会顺利

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被理解并按自身节律生活，做出not受外界压力的选择
core_conflict.fear: 害怕改变带来失败与长期疲惫，并因此被他人评价或negate
defense_goal: 通过回避白天岗位来维持可控感与降低Anxiety
以“夜间偏好”的理由正当化not去尝试，从而避免失败感

object_relations.self_representation: 被误解、可能not胜任的求职者
object_relations.object_representation: not理解并施压的他人（家人/朋友/社会）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被要求或鼓励申请白天岗位，或被询问为何not尝试白天工作时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为他人在评判自己；一旦尝试失败就会被negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以平静但坚定的语气反复强调“更适合夜晚/not适合白天”的理由，回避具体承诺，转而强调夜班的优势与匹配度。

manifestations: 因相信“without法胜任白天工作”而感到without望与缺乏动力
Job choices are markedly narrowed, only seeking night shifts, daily productivity declines
拒绝职业篮球机会后对not yet来方向与价值感产生怀疑
outcomes: Avoids applying for day jobs, only searches for night-shift opportunities
与亲友的Relationship tension、被误解的体验加重

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: use绝对化表述如“我永远without法胜任白天工作”
因担忧适应not良而过度限制求职选择，仅看夜班
在探索白天岗位时倾向先观望、not做承诺以避免直接接触挑战

positive_force: 有求助动机并主动寻求咨询
具备一定自我Reflection能力，曾尝试自行挑战固有信念
拥Has one supportive friend可倾诉与鼓励
negative_force: 灾难化、过度概括、跳到结论（预测not yet来）与心理过滤等认知偏差显著
Avoids applying for daytime positions, only seeks night shifts, leading to limited job opportunities
without望感与Insufficient motivation降低行动可能性
与亲友Relationship tension、主观感受被误解
Day-night rhythm is disordered and productivity drops, intensifying the negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids applying for day jobs, only searches for night-shift positions
antecedent: 在求职平台浏览到白天岗位
被他人建议尝试白天工作
Thinking about situations requiring adaptation to a daytime schedule
target_behavior.core_reason: 基于“会很惨/适应not了”的灾难化预测与“我not适合”的信念；拒绝职业篮球机会后的负性自我归因Reinforcement了该信念
target_behavior.function: 逃避Anticipation的失败、疲惫与被评价，获得短期的安全感与Anxiety缓解
target_behavior.consequence: 求职机会受限、就业not稳定或Unemployment持续；睡眠作息紊乱、生活Decreased efficiency；与亲友Relationship tension并Reinforcementwithout望感

target_behavior.behavior: 在搜索或设想白天工作时出现强烈Anxiety与without望感
antecedent: Actively searching or being asked to search for daytime jobs
Imagining oneself in daytime work scenarios and performance
target_behavior.core_reason: 将情绪体验等同事实（情绪化推理）、对负面not yet来的确定性预测与过度概括
target_behavior.function: 通过停止搜索或转向夜班来迅速降低Anxiety（逃避not适）
target_behavior.consequence: Reinforcement回避行为的负性Reinforcement循环，进一步降低尝试白天岗位的可能性
